name: Release Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test on Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.6"
          - "3.7"
          - "3.8"
          - "3.9"
          - "3.10"
          - "3.11"
          - "3.12"
          - "3.13"
          - "3.14"
          - "3.14-experimental"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
          pip install -e .[dev] || pip install -e .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest

yaml:
name: Release Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    name: Test on Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version:
          - "3.6"
          - "3.7"
          - "3.8"
          - "3.9"
          - "3.10"
          - "3.11"
          - "3.12"
          - "3.13"
          - "3.14"
          - "3.14-experimental"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: pip

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
          pip install -e .[dev] || pip install -e .

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          pytest
